## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit or regression tests added/updated
- [ ] Typecheck passed
- [ ] Package checks passed when public API or packaging changed
- [ ] Browser tests passed when transport or lifecycle behavior changed
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Changeset added, or an empty changeset explains why no release is needed

## Public API

List any runtime exports, type exports, documented behavior, or error codes that
change. Write "None" when the public API is unchanged.
